name: Lacrosse 26
summary: Lacrosse 26 is a lacrosse experience built from the ground up to feel real. Powered by a motion-matching animation system and all-new motion capture, every movement on the field is dynamic. Players don’t just trigger animations, they react. Speed, direction, stick position, and player input all blend in real time, creating gameplay that feels fluid, grounded, and authentic to the sport. With hundreds of unique animations—from dodges and cuts to passes, checks, and goalie saves—Lacrosse 26 captures the nuance of lacrosse like never before. Whether you’re splitting defenders, snapping off a quick-stick finish, or chasing down a ground ball, every moment in Lacrosse is driven by the player's timing, not canned sequences. Build your program in Dynasty Mode, where recruiting, player development, and scheduling shape your path from underdog to powerhouse. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, manage resources, and compete against increasingly difficult opponents as you climb the ranks.
